verdict_basis: No concrete numeric-comparison bug was found. WARN is retained because exact GT payload provenance was not independently inspected and the evidence is one fixed internal-DEV run, not because the observed negative delta is intrinsically suspicious.

A_ground_truth_provenance.details: The CPU worker loads a distinct DEV COCO JSON and uses that COCO object as the GT side of COCOeval. Predictions are loaded separately with loadRes; no model output is used as GT. The registry provides DEV bytes/SHA but is explicitly a not-run future registry, and this reviewer could not read the remote DEV payload or certify its upstream identity.

B_scoring_and_normalization.details: Original finite S0 in [0,1] is preserved exactly; only segmentation changes. Raw COCO12 values are retained. Per-IoU percent is 100 times raw precision and differences are percentage points, not prediction-derived self-normalization.

C_numeric_existence_and_original_termina.details: Existing acceptance and observed-postcheck files record tool/SSH/worker exit 0, full populations, and complete metrics. Read-only local structural comparisons found observed stdout equal to acceptance postcheck and public results/differences equal to CPU acceptance. This does not independently prove the entire remote execution or all bytes behind referenced hashes.

D_metric_function_invocation.details: The CPU method loop calls official_metrics for native, R, and SAMRefiner. official_metrics calls coco_metrics, captures one COCOeval, and coco_metrics executes evaluate, accumulate, and summarize. Outputs appear in acceptance/public files.

E_scope_seed_semantics_full.details: Evidence is one fixed-author/default, fixed-S0 run on internal historically exposed DEV187/380 with one recorded seed. FULL187 means the complete 187-image DEV roster and all 100 queries, not FULL_E50, official TEST, convergence, seed robustness, SOTA, or TGRS readiness.

author_source_check.tuple_and_row_conclusion: author_packet[0] is refined_masks; the author loops over SAM mask/IoU rows, selects one of three masks by per-row predicted-IoU argmax, appends and stacks in row order, then asserts output count equals input count. No cross-row sorting/reorder path was found.

supported: The supplied Root-accepted artifacts record the three COCO metric sets for one fixed internal-DEV recipe.
Under full native candidate population and unchanged S0, the recorded SAMRefiner AP is 0.4277065358 versus native 0.6707105664 and R 0.6809938495.
The metric functions are actually invoked and the raw results are not self-normalized.
Exact pinned upstream author source supports refined_masks as tuple element zero and preserves cross-row order while selecting one of three masks per row by predicted-IoU argmax.
unsupported: SAMRefiner is generally ineffective or harmful beyond this exact recipe, data split, and fixed-score policy.
FULL_E50, blind TEST, convergence, seed robustness, external SOTA, innovation, or TGRS readiness.
A same-training-budget superiority or inferiority claim against external methods.
Independent proof by this reviewer of all earlier Root remote-execution facts or remote GT/prediction bytes.
A claim that any exploratory coarse-refined best-IoU matching proves row permutation or licenses post-hoc S0 remapping.
untested: Direct GT payload provenance/content and upstream dataset identity.
Repeatability across executions, seeds, or platforms.
Runtime per-iteration three-mask branch values and selections, which were not retained in the accepted export.
Decomposition of loss into geometry degradation, stale external S0 ranking, and internal branch selection.

minimum_interpretation_changing_diagnost.primary: Using preserved same-index identities, compute native-versus-refined per-query GT IoU changes and all-100 best-over-query GT coverage, stratified by original S0 rank. This distinguishes geometry collapse from retained oracle coverage with stale ranking without changing accepted AP.
minimum_interpretation_changing_diagnost.prospective_extension: On a separate predeclared diagnostic run, instrument the unchanged author loop to retain all three masks, predicted-IoU values, and selected branch per row/iteration. Use GT only to diagnose branch quality, never to select a branch for reportable AP.
minimum_interpretation_changing_diagnost.pairwise_matrix_limit: A 100x100 coarse-refined IoU matrix is exploratory only. Refinement and query overlap can change best matches, so it cannot prove row permutation, justify rebinding S0/query identity, or produce rescued AP.
